core_idea: Blade Lineage Salsu Don Quixote is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist — **Poise** fighter — stack on self, then spend on crits and scaling. High-variance kit — S3 only reach full damage on Heads flips.
playstyle_guide:
- Build **Poise Count** and **Potency** for crits and Coin Power scaling before committing **Fare Thee Well!** — **S1 — Draw of the Sword** adds **+2 Poise Count** at **On Use** and **+1 Poise** per **Heads Hit** coin; **S2 — Blade Arc** adds **+2 Poise Count** at **On Use** and **+2 Poise** per **On Hit** coin.
- **Fare Thee Well!** is your highest-damage skill — use the setup skills above first, then commit it once stacks are up.
- S3 lose most of their output on Tails — commit them on turns you already expect to win the clash, and lead with the other slots otherwise.
- Hold S3 for when At 10+ Poise on self is met — that condition is what unlocks its full damage ceiling.

**S1 — Draw of the Sword** (BP 3, CP +4, x2): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low / Slightly High stacked).
- Needs 5+ Poise on self to activate — prioritise building stacks before using.

**S2 — Blade Arc** (BP 4, CP +5, x2): rolls — low 4, high 14 (Slightly Low).
- Needs 7+ Poise on self to activate — prioritise building stacks before using.

**S3 — Fare Thee Well!** (BP 4, CP +3, x3): rolls — low 4, high 13 (Low / Average stacked).
- Needs 10+ Poise on self to activate — prioritise building stacks before using.
- The final Coin deals +10% damage
- To 2 allies that either have no Poise or have the least Poise Count, apply +2 Poise Count; [Attack End] If target is defeated, gain 1 Slash DMG Up next turn

Combat passive — **Nightly Stroll**: 1 ally that has the least Poise gains 2 more Poise Potency when gaining Poise Potency using its own Skill or Coin effects (max 2 times.
  - does not apply to allies that do not have Poise).
